description: Lists profit and loss report in Xero. This provides a summary of revenue, expenses, and profit or loss over a specified period of time.

fromDate.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

paymentsOnly.description: Optional flag to include only accounts with payments

periods.description: Optional number of periods to compare

standardLayout.description: Optional flag to use standard layout

timeframe.description: Optional timeframe for the report (MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR)

toDate.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: list-profit-and-loss
